title: WebSocket messages: fragments joined, control frames interleaved, close frames decoded
spec: Implement Assembler::push and to_frame as the doc comments say. Frame, Opcode and WsError come from ws_frame (their stubs and the WsError variants for this task already exist, so this compiles before T208 lands). Guard the size before copying: a frame that would push the message over max_message is refused without appending it. Delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` on the stubs. No new dependencies.
